mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget_item (plan_id, dept_id, subject_id, month, amount, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{cell.planId}, #{cell.deptId}, #{cell.subjectId}, #{cell.month}, #{cell.amount}, #{cell.createBy}, NOW(), #{cell.updateBy}, NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount = VALUES(amount), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = NOW(), deleted = 0
